title: Scuffed!
description: A magic-tech modpack combining Create engineering and Hex Casting magic, built for exploration, automation, and smooth performance.
body:
# Hello

### INFO / What pack about.
This modpack fuses the creative engineering of Create with the arcane power of Hex Casting and its many expansions like Hex Machina and Hexxy Dimensions. Build massive factories, design magical contraptions, and experiment with new tools, armor, and trims. With optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix, plus visual polish from Not Enough Animations and Dynamic Lights, it runs fast and feels alive. Whether you’re exploring, automating, or enchanting—this world is yours to shape.
## Help
Join either [Scuffed Discord](https://discord.gg/cJQxfZVEGE) or [My Discord](https://discord.gg/gwMJytq7uJ)
